page.content:
Woking constructor of Senna, Prost, and later title hunts.

How McLaren connects

  • Character: Ayrton Senna — Ayrton Senna won his three titles with McLaren.
  • Character: Alain Prost — Alain Prost won titles as Senna's McLaren teammate and rival.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — McLaren is the British constructor of the Senna–Prost era.

What is McLaren?

McLaren is the British team of the Honda turbo years, the Senna–Prost war, and later constructors' campaigns that still treat the papaya car as a title threat.

Key threads lead to Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost and Formula 1.
